title: Parent / guardian access
subtitle: Sign in to save your children's progress in the cloud.

mode.toggleToSignUp: Don't have an account? Create one
mode.toggleToSignIn: Already have an account? Sign in

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.body: We've sent a verification link to your email. Confirm it to enable cloud saving.
verify.pending: Your email is not verified yet.

consent.title: What we store
consent.intro: Before saving anything in the cloud, please read this and give your consent.
consent.storedAccount: Your parent/guardian account: email and password (used only to sign you in).
consent.storedProgress: Each child profile's learning progress and their chosen avatar and nickname (from a fixed list).
consent.notStoredChild: Any personal data that identifies the child (no real name, birth date, photo or email). The child has no account.
consent.notStoredPin: The child's PIN never leaves the device; it is only a local lock.
consent.accept: I have read this and I consent
consent.mustAccept: You must give consent to enable cloud saving. You can keep using the app locally.

reset.title: Reset your password
reset.sent: If that email has an account, we've sent a reset link.

localMode.title: Cloud saving is not set up
localMode.body: The app works fully on this device. Cloud saving will be available once the parent account is configured.

errors.emailInUse: That email already has an account. Try signing in.
errors.invalidEmail: That email address doesn't look valid.
errors.weakPassword: Please choose a stronger password (at least 8 characters).
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment and try again.
errors.network: Network problem. Check your connection and try again.
errors.requiresRecentLogin: For security, please sign in again to continue.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
